services.name: Spreading of the Ashes 6 Passengers
services.desc: Rates Up to 6 People - PRICES MAY BE HIGHER ON HOLIDAYS Duration 2.5- 3 hours About PLEASE NOTE: The Captain may change the time of your departure based upon his discretion (weather, sea conditions, time of year etc). You will be notified via email and or text message The scattering of a loved ones ashes at sea is a honored tradition dating back many years that is becoming increasingly popular. Enchanted Sailing Charters understands that saying goodbye is never an easy thing to do. Our crew has overseen ashes spread at sea for over 12 years with courtesy, respect and professionalism. When we leave the marina, we travel down the Intracoastal waterway, then out 3 miles for the ash scattering.

services.name: Sunset Dinner: Birthday or Anniversary Cruise

Surrounded by some of South Carolina's most expansive scenery, you'll enjoy a private catered dinner while taking in natural wildlife and fresh ocean air. We'll depart Cricket Cove Marina and begin our scenic cruise on the Intracoastal Waterway, just in time to catch the sun go down in the West over the Waterway with a beautiful birds-eye view. Kick back and relax with your beverage and give a toast to the evening ahead!
